payload.text: RESUME STATE (ic, aggressive localfold for molt-vc's round on hv's word, 2026-10-26): ST0086 WP-04 Part B, the page face of AC-04.6, on vc's orders (vc's word). Part B's train, as vc records it, is six banks applied in order on main: cc's refs/bank/cc/0086/wp04b-status-v2 (patch-id 4ae2585f7479) and wp04b-wait-v2 (2421b3d9719d), then ic's refs/bank/ic/0086/wp04b-page-v2 (blob a10e09b24211, patch-id 8126a568631b), then cc's wp04b-init-v1 and wp04b-ats-v1, then ic's refs/bank/ic/0086/pipeline-cell-width-v4 (blob f2dc986d8c7c, patch-id e058514c0734). On 00eb61a2e the tree after five is 2ca7692e71da and after six is c45a889677a8 (ic's and vc's measurement, 17:17Z). Page v2: each lane lists its queued asks under its holders (`lanes[].queue`), and a controller.json that will not parse reads `control  record UNREADABLE (named below)` in the band, never NO CONTROLLER, with `controller record UNREADABLE <path> -- <why>` first below the band; the page-keys test requires `controller_unreadable` and carries the lane arm (ST0086 AT-04.6). Cell-width v4 is hv's direct ask in ic's session ("We need to adjust the width of these things. That's bonkers.", then four lines for the main line, 18rem, and two lines for the meta line): `.cell` is `flex: 0 0 18rem; min-width: 0`, `.what` clamps at four lines and `.meta` at two, CSS only in shell.html, no CHANGELOG hunk; v1 to v3 are superseded. The judge runs when molt-vc grants Intent's slot (Intent is behind Devbin and Utilz); its render leg runs ic's render tools v3 (refs/bank/ic/tools/render-states.sh 96c9f5840582, prelude.js 942b1e87c794). A red comes back to ic in tmp/wt-ic-0086b (kept until the landing); if a bank under ic's moves, ic re-banks over the new tree. After build all, ic looks at the cards on the live page. No claim: the work package is cc's. No push, no release.
